items: **Schedule uncertainty:** The public schedule is presented as a launch listing rather than an official fixed ISRO mission page, so the date should be treated as **provisional** until ISRO confirms it on its own launch list or another official update.

components.text: ISRO’s official launch missions page currently shows the latest completed launch as **GSLV-F17/EOS-05** on September 4, 2026, and does not yet list a later upcoming mission in the visible entries, which is why the next launch date is being inferred from third-party schedule trackers.[1][5]
